gold_facts.text: Where an employee or other auxiliary committed the act of unfair competition in the course of their work, the actions provided for against unfair competition that the article refers to can also be brought against the employer, not only against the employee.

competing_candidates: The Code of Obligations article on the employer's liability for damage caused by employees (it concerns damages, while the question asks to stop and correct the conduct).
provenance.writer_note: Round 2: fact reworded to the reference wording of the gold article, per critic.

question: Un venditore di una ditta concorrente, durante le sue visite ai clienti, racconta che i miei prodotti sono pericolosi, cosa falsa. Per farlo smettere e far chiarire le cose davanti ai clienti, posso agire in giudizio direttamente contro la ditta per cui lavora, oppure solo contro di lui?
